deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1, 2026 for domestic and international applicants; later applications reviewed as space and funding allow.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required but may be submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission consideration but may be submitted if desired.

also.quote: We do not require GRE scores for graduate admission. The GRE is recommended but not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

fee_waiver.value: The department does not provide application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: The Department of Chemistry does not provide application fee waivers.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the page checked

funding.value: All admitted students get five years of support as a TA or RA, with stipend, tuition waiver and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the Chemistry graduate program receive support for five years, either as a teaching assistant or a research assistant.

notes: Fall admission only; no stand-alone master's. International admits attend the ACES English programme.
